result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 2 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    # locate full horizontal and vertical divider lines
    hr=next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and sum(grid[r][c]==grid[r][0] for c in range(w))==w)
    vc=next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==grid[hr][0] for r in range(h)))
    cross=grid[hr][0]
    # background is the most frequent value outside the divider
    from collections import Counter
    vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r!=hr and c!=vc]
    bg=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r!=hr and c!=vc and grid[r][c]!=bg and grid[r][c]!=cross]
    r0=0 if any(r<hr for r,c in pts) else hr+1
    r1=hr if r0==0 else h
    c0=0 if any(c<vc for r,c in pts) else vc+1
    c1=vc if c0==0 else w
    return [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    # locate full separator row and column (the cross)
    sr=next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1)
    sc=next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))
    # background is the most frequent value away from separator
    vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r!=sr for c in range(w) if c!=sc]
    bg=max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    rs=[range(0,sr),range(sr+1,h)]
    cs=[range(0,sc),range(sc+1,w)]
    for ri,rr in enumerate(rs):
        for ci,cc in enumerate(cs):
            q=[[grid[r][c] for c in cc] for r in rr]
            if any(x!=bg for row in q for x in row):
                return q
    return []"}
